measurement_validity.rule: STATUS.md 5.1: heavy tasks (full test suite + benchmarks) only when load1 < 2.5 / MemAvail >= 2.5G and alone

regression_policy.rule: Any hot-path regression >10% is a BLOCKER: RPS down >10% OR latency (p50/p95/p99) up >10% vs the baseline.

direction.taux_erreur_pct: any increase above baseline is suspicious

sources: task t_ef01fc51 body (user contract): 'flag any regression >10% as blocker'
task t_8106f197 body: 'if any regression is >10%, mark the gate as BLOCKER'
benchmarks/results/gate_compare.py docstring: hot-path regression >10% on RPS (down) or p50/p95/p99 (up) => FAIL

validation_finding.detail: gate_compare.py docstring promises p50/p95/p99 in the >10% rule, but the implementation only flags rps < -10% OR p50 > 10% OR p95 > 10% — p99 is NOT enforced. A p99-only regression (>10%) would pass the automated comparator. Recommending fix: add p99 to the flag condition, or amend the docstring to match code.
